_comment: Recipe for volatile remote document corpora synced by `make docs-refresh` (jarvisrag.docsync). The document LIST (names + URLs) is committed here; the downloaded files and per-file fetch state (.docsync_state.json) stay LOCAL/gitignored under each set's corpus_dir. A refresh rewrites a file only when its content actually changed (sha256), so the index manifest + delta-sync re-embed just the changed chunks into Milvus. Production promotion (indexing corpus_dir into jarvis_context) is a separate, gated step. A set with "type": "mail" instead syncs a LOCAL Apple Mail store (.emlx message files) into corpus_dir via refresh_mail_set (copy-first, delta-only, never locks Mail); it needs Full Disk Access and no committed document list.

sets.name: fedbenefits
sets._note: US federal retirement-benefit rules (OPM CSRS/FERS Handbook + SSA pubs + TSP booklets/fact sheets + the IRS annual retirement COLA notice). Volatile: updated on policy/administration changes. Complements the eCFR MCP connector (which serves live Title-5 CFR text) with plain-language computation guidance. tsp.gov returns 403 to a bare user agent, which the shared browser headers already handle. The IRS COLA notice carries the YEAR-SPECIFIC dollar limits (elective deferral, catch-up, IRA) that the TSP fact sheets deliberately omit so they do not go stale and that the Internal Revenue Code states only as a cost-of-living adjustment — without it no source in this set answers 'what is the limit this year'. It is republished annually under a new notice number, so this URL needs a yearly bump; the companion IRS limits PAGE (.html) is the self-updating hedge — the IRS revises it in place each year at a stable URL, so a plain refresh picks up new figures without editing this recipe. Keep BOTH: the notice is the citable authority, the page is the one that stays current on its own. Employer-plan rules here are NOT federal-only even though the TSP booklets describe them in TSP terms: the SECURE 2.0 section 603 Roth catch-up requirement amends IRC 414(v)(7) and governs every applicable employer plan (401(k), 403(b), governmental 457(b), TSP). Notice 2023-62 is carried as the plan-agnostic statement of that rule so an answer is not framed as TSP-specific when the user means a private 401(k).
sets.label: Federal retirement benefits (OPM/SSA)

sets.name: mail
sets._note: Local Apple Mail corpus with its own collection jarvis_domain_mail. Domain retrieval is selected by match_any and conversation routing; separate storage does not yet enforce mail-only answers or block MCP dispatch. refresh_mail_set copies changed individual .emlx files before parsing, never opens Mail's Envelope Index, preserves identical staged bytes and timestamps, and aborts incomplete scans without pruning. De-duplication is always on by RFC Message-ID, with path identity when absent. Full Disk Access is required only for refresh. Legacy whole-second sync state requires one-time copy-and-hash verification. The domain self-activates once corpus_dir exists; full-build retention, routing, and answer accuracy still require validation.
sets.label: Apple Mail (local, on-device)
